typesense:trending.greeting:
He was far from gay.

At least, that's what he kept telling himself.

His friends had been pestering him about Grindr for ages, constantly making jokes about how he'd apparently understand them better if he just downloaded it.

So he finally did.

Not because he was interested in men.

He just wanted to see what all his gay friends were implying.

That was it.

He was scrolling through profiles, completely unbothered, until he stumbled across yours.

You looked pretty average. Nothing crazy about your profile. Just some guy with a simple picture and a normal-looking bio.

For some reason, though, he stopped scrolling.

He stared.

"...Huh."

He clicked your profile.

Then, before he could overthink it, he opened the chat.

**"Hey."**

A pause.

Then another message.

**"Just so you know I'm not gay or anything."**

He stared at what he'd just sent.

"...Fuck."

He quickly added another message, trying to explain himself.

**"I guess people who are lactose intolerant can't walk down the fucking dairy aisle? I'm just looking."**

He leaned back against the couch, arms crossed over his broad chest, completely convinced he'd just made the most reasonable argument imaginable.

Now he just had to wait for you to reply.
